body_markdown:
## Hello! Who are you and what business did you start?

I am an Author, LifeCoach Astropsychologist, Clairvoyant, Spiritual Therapist, Astrologer, and Teacher at [Ask Holly Hal](https://askhollyhall.com/)l. At a young age, I recognized my relationship with The Universe.

The information I received gave me an uncommon, and yet powerful understanding of the totality of individuals, their souls, and their relevance to the universe. As well as the various dimensions of existence. I bring advanced and ancient teachings to this powerful prophecy and knowledge for my clients and in my work.

I'm a life coach who has been highly endorsed by parenting clinical psychologist Dr. Shefali and has been on Oprah over two dozen times along with many other Prime TV shows.

I am known as the Clairvoyant life coach, I work with several modalities to consult my clients regularly. I have a background in education and philosophy and psychology, I am a master astrologer, I am certified in neural link whilst programming, a type of psychology, certified as a past life regression hypnosis therapist, and certified in Time Line therapy. I am also Clairvoyant with the ability in remote viewing. Because of all of these talents, I'm able to see my clients on a very deep level that would take several sessions in consulting or therapy for that professional to understand, which I can see within the first 10 minutes. I'm also just able to see the environment around their past, present, and future, I do not take away free will, I can lay out the map for the future it's up to them how they choose to navigate it, however, my coaching ability assists them to make the best choices so they can go create their future. This also helps them understand and supports them in their connection with their loved ones. Relationships change from that moment on.

My average income is around $5,000-8000 a month.

My mission is to grow and help others advance through the understanding of our evolutionary process to ascend. Individually and collectively. Teaching you everything that builds up our reality. Together, we mutually discover your existence, your meaning, your relationships with people, your life, your career, and your connection with the universe or source.

Understand the importance of your presence as a fundamental part of this continuous existence, called life. One reading will do just that! Co-Create your future with a higher vibration.

## What's your backstory and how did you come up with the idea?

I’ve been seeking to understand the Meaning of Life since I was a young child. Born and raised in a Roman Catholic religion, while adversely raised by two hippy-like, psychic, talented, and creative parents.

At age 13 I was told I was psychic and a third-generation psychic (mom’s side), yet I had a rather rational and scientific mind. In my early 20s, I shifted into Agnosticism and decided that science and energy were the meaning of our reality and our life.

Next in a conversation, a co-worker suggested I may relate to the science/math of astrology and lent me a book. Before dismissing that this could mean anything, of course, I embarked on some scientific research by reading the book, and I was astounded!

This was a memory, a language, I had long forgotten. I evolved immediately, simultaneously with other modalities such as my receiving answers as I sleep (dreams), and even in the form of daydreams for others. As the years progressed I found myself speaking silently to what I call ‘Source’ or the Universal Mind – detailed in [my book.](https://www.amazon.com/101-Answers-Universe-Eyes-Wide/dp/B084PY9VDZ?ie=UTF8&language=en_US&tag=starterstory-20)

## Take us through the process of designing your services.

I married Science with Spirituality and studied Psychology, Hypnotherapy, NLP, and more. From there I developed a unique way of learning how to read people’s souls. Their Meaning of Life is discovered through my sessions and reading the purpose of every person and touching their soul. Trust me you will feel it when this happens.

What is a soul? What is soul Ascension? What is life? Why are we here? Why are you here? Day to day, moment by moment, making choices to evolve. Understanding others in your life and so much more!

## Describe the process of launching the business.

As a serial entrepreneur, I ran an online radio station for almost 8 years. During that time I did some readings but very few. In one of my episodes, I interviewed a clinical psychologist who specializes in parenting, called Dr. Shefali. At the time she had just submitted a book to Oprah and as a pro bono I did a reading for her, she asked if her book would succeed.

This was in November 2010, I told her that Oprah would accept the book and by the following February, she would be off the map so popular she wouldn't even remember who I am. Which is exactly what happened. Dr. Shefali has been on Oprah over two dozen times or more, as well as many TV shows and famous YouTubers such as Russell Brand.

Several years later, although I did some readings on online platforms I wasn't super busy but I still delivered a couple of readings for Dr. Shefali. Then my uncle had suggested I should ask her to endorse me, I resisted at first and then said ‘why not’, I emailed her and said ‘hey would you consider endorsing me, she said call me, and within 24 hours my inbox was inundated with so many people willing to do a reading that it crashed.

> Stay connected to your people, offer them advice, free suggestions, make it personal, and touch base with them as human beings.

And thanks to my experience with online radio I knew how to set up a website, a scheduling system, and a mailing contact form within 10 hours. Now four years later I've been booked solid ever since, publishing companies recommend me, Shefali has continued to recommend me and promote me.

Although my radio business was the original project that began my current business as a clairvoyant astrologer life coach, I do have to include this in part of my expenses.

I had approached my local entrepreneurial startup government program and pitched my radio project and found an investor. He invested a total of $25,000.

Unfortunately, we were sharpened by a large radio platform called TuneIn, connected to Rakatan, a large Japanese company that is basically the equivalent to the westernized Amazon and also owns the reading tablet called Kubo.

They Flew to Toronto and had a meeting with me. We found out that all they wanted was enough information to reproduce my radio program on their own and considering that they are a multi-billion-dollar company, they quickly squeezed me out of the game. However, It did introduce me to Dr. Shefali ultimately helped me launch the career that I truly love and have now.

## Since launch, what has worked to attract and retain customers?

I will tell you that most of what has helped me to continue to maintain and increase my business is keeping a close connection with my clients. I have not done any advertising. I have my podcast, YouTube channel, blogging platform, and I would say the most successful is my live Facebook events, where I do free readings.

On my website, I offer a 20% discount if they sign up for my newsletter. I use my newsletter a couple of times a month to keep in touch with my clients. I also offer irresistible discounts 3 to 5 times a year. Many of my clients will sign up for packages in which they will have several readings from me and coaching sessions.

Encourage them to have readings around their career, their health, their spouses, their partners, their family members, their childhood trauma, their children, etc. Many of my clients come highly recommended by other clients. I have had the same clients for well over four years.

## How are you doing today and what does the future look like?

Today I'm still able to maintain my business. However, I am not booked as far in advance as I was at the beginning. I would like to reach a broader audience. My goal now is to continue my podcasting. I would like to be interviewed on more and more podcasts. Somehow find a way to convince podcasters how popular it is to have someone like me on their show. People want to be read, people want to be heard, the interesting thing is when they do have a reading or a session live on a podcast they go back and listen to it over and over again. This is advantageous to both of us. As I share this with my clients as well.

Since writing my book 101 answers from the Universe, it has sold a few hundred copies on Amazon. My two-year goal is to rewrite and publish it again with a Publishing Company.

## Through starting the business, have you learned anything particularly helpful or advantageous?

Stay connected to your people, offer them advice, free suggestions, make it personal, and touch base with them as human beings. . I become like family, their best friend, their therapist, their consultants, and someone that knows them on a deeper level than anyone, even more so than themselves.

If there's a way that you can incorporate that into your business even if you're just selling widgets, find a way. This can mean that you do live on Facebook or Tik-Tok were you 2 people like to see people, people like to connect, it makes him feel important and understood and valued.

The other way that I have grown is through my talents and gifts in general. I have developed remote healing, remote viewing, clairvoyance, I have studied past life regression therapy, an NLP, and all of this helps support, heal and work with my clients.

## What platform/tools do you use for your business?

I use Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Spotify, Apple podcast, Google, Google podcast, and anchors. FM, medium.com on my website.

## What have been the most influential books, podcasts, or other resources?

I can't say that there are any influential books or podcasts or other resources that I use. Because of the nature of my work I tend to go within. I meditate. I listen to what the source/my guides have to say and tell me what to do.

## Advice for other entrepreneurs who want to get started or are just starting out?

This is a great question because many of my clients ask for business coaching, as I'm able to design ideas that come from Source or my Spirit guides as well as my common sense and look up astrologically, windows of opportunity/timelines for my clients.

I guess my number one advice would be; don't do it just for the money. I know that's a hard pill to swallow. However, if your main motivation (above your talents) is simply for the money, then that's coming out of need and greed.

The universe doesn't work that way, energy doesn't work that way as it can be based on the fear of not having. Do not follow those gurus who sell you how you can generate tens of thousands of dollars a month. It's a waste of your time and energy.

Go within, take a look at your fears, deconstruct them, use them as courage to guide you away from a life that you're not happy with, into a life that you are happy with. Look at your own childhood experiences, how difficult was that? And as challenging as it may be, what lessons did you learn from that and how can you help other people just like you.

Often that's exactly why we were born to experience what we did was so that we could develop skill sets that would further help heal and develop others.

Whether you are creating a product, using it to help people in your day-to-day job even if it's a cashier, or through being a mother or a parent, finding out with your purposes fulfilling that Destiny is what will create your success on all levels not just money.

I've seen magic happen with my clients and with myself, the abundance that does not come in the form of a dollar bill, a credit card, or what's in my bank account. This is the best advice I could give.
